notes: Section 4.5.7 RTSP of the official WIP6F Network Camera User Manual (genieproducts.co.uk) documents the RTSP address format. Unicast paths are /profile1 (main stream) and /profile2 (sub stream). The manual also references /profile3 for a third stream on the fisheye model. Multicast appends ?transportmode=mcast to the same path. The manual example is rtsp://192.168.226.201:554/profile1. Applies to Genie WISH IP (WIP) series cameras.
